reviewer: Codex main agent; lower-cost agents gathered context and retrieval evidence only
summary: Rejected on repeated one-time payoffs and concrete continuity/cost defects. All scoped cards and their first three non-self retrieval candidates were read in full.

issues.problem: The knowing pool describes one-time payoffs, but repeat: 1 permits another showing after a month. These 15 cards have fixed scenes and no completion gate. They can stage the same problem and resolution again, including with the same classmate when per: x is used.
issues.fix: Remove the cooldown from the shared pool through the project migration workflow for one-time payoffs. Give any intentionally recurring card a suitable cooldown and variation that accounts for prior outcomes.

issues.problem: The successful advance-purchase branch adds gold +medium after charging the discounted price, but the say only says the bought supplies last the term. It describes avoided later spending, not receiving a payment or refund.
issues.fix: Describe an actual refund/resale/payment if the purse should grow, or model the successful bargain without minting an unexplained cash reward.

issues.problem: The option deducts study while describing a week persuading a friend and watching Amaranth copy their remedy. Its say does not identify the player’s skipped lecture, neglected revision or unfinished coursework. Time spent on the activity alone does not identify an academic loss.
issues.fix: Show the particular academic work sacrificed in each affected outcome, or use a cost the described activity actually shows. Keep an academic cost meaningful on any eligible break.
